screens.title: Empty Whiteboard Canvas (Light Theme)
screens.description: Initial mount of @excalidraw/excalidraw v0.18.1 at 1280x800 showing #ffffff canvas, top-center floating toolbar island with selection tool active, top-left menu trigger, top-right library trigger, bottom-left zoom/undo controls, and bottom-right help button.

screens.title: Hand-Drawn Primitives & Bound Arrow Scene (Light Theme)
screens.description: Canvas populated via live toolbar selection and pointer drag with 4 elements: rounded rectangle (260,180,220x140), ellipse (700,180,200x140), bound arrow connecting rectangle right edge to ellipse left edge, and text element 'Excalidraw Parity Spec' at (440,420).

screens.title: Dark Theme Canvas & Chrome Token Switch
screens.description: Same 4-element scene switched to dark theme (.excalidraw.theme--dark) showing #121212 canvas background, #232329 chrome island surfaces, #403e6a active tool highlight, and CSS canvas filter invert(93%) hue-rotate(180deg) while preserving raw element colors in JSON.

screens.title: Selected Element & Left Properties Inspector
screens.description: Rectangle element selected on canvas displaying bounding box with transform handles and left properties inspector (200x634 island at x=16,y=76) after mutating strokeColor to #e03131, backgroundColor to #a5d8ff, and roughness to 2 (Cartoonist).

screens.title: Excalidraw v2 JSON Export, Clear, and Restore Roundtrip
screens.description: Scene serialized via serializeAsJSON (type='excalidraw', version=2), cleared to 0 elements, restored via restore() + updateScene(), and persisted to host localStorage ('excalidraw' and 'excalidraw-state') with identical element IDs and geometry.
